requirement.title: Learning requirements summary
requirement.saveFailed: Requirements were not saved. Please try again.
requirement.introduction: Once the Agent understands your goals, background, and expectations, it will summarize your requirements here. A Learning path will only be generated after you confirm them.
requirement.unavailableIntroduction: The Agent is unavailable. Fill in and confirm your learning requirements manually; a Learning path will not be generated automatically.
requirement.question: Question
requirement.awaitingSummary: The Agent will summarize your requirements from the conversation. You can also enter them directly. Planning begins only after confirmation.
requirement.confirmHint: After confirmation, the Agent will use these requirements to plan your Learning path
requirement.manualHint: Save and confirm your learning requirements manually. The Agent is unavailable and will not plan a Learning path automatically
requirement.empty: No requirements have been summarized yet. Continue the conversation or add questions and answers directly.
requirement.questionRequired: Fill in the question in each row. You can leave answers blank if you are unsure.
requirement.loadingReadiness: Loading requirements readiness. Please try again shortly.
requirement.correctionHint: Not accurate? Edit directly or tell the Agent more on the left
requirement.manualCorrectionHint: Not accurate? Edit directly. The conversation on the left only saves questions; it will not summarize requirements or generate a Learning path.

onboarding.saveQuestionFailed: Your question was not saved. Please try again.
onboarding.greeting: Hi, I’m your learning Agent. Tell me what you want to learn and what you want to achieve, and I’ll help plan a Learning path that suits you.
onboarding.unavailableGreeting: The Agent is unavailable. This conversation only saves your questions and will not generate replies. Please edit and confirm your learning requirements on the right.
onboarding.placeholder: Tell the Agent your learning goals, or continue the conversation…
onboarding.planningFallback: The complete Learning path has not been saved. Try planning again or return to edit your learning requirements.
onboarding.planningNote: This step only generates the Learning path and Unit outlines. Each Unit’s Lesson will be generated when you enter that Unit, based on your learning progress at that time.

questions.unconfirmed: Answer submission was not confirmed. Your input is preserved. Try again or continue explaining in the conversation.
questions.saveFailed: Answers were not saved. Please try again.
questions.answeredSummary: Clarifying questions · Answered · View original questions and answers
questions.supersededSummary: Clarifying questions · Superseded · View original questions and answers
questions.superseded: No answers were submitted; this round was superseded by later requirements or questions.
questions.instructions: Answer one at a time, then submit all together. You can also continue the conversation in the input below.
questions.singleHint: Choose one or write your own

research.exportFailed: Could not export research. Please try again.
research.title: Research preview

research.discardQuestion: You have unsaved changes. Discard and close?
research.saveHint: Saving creates a new revision and requires reconfirming learning requirements. Existing Learning paths and Lessons keep their original revisions.

route.addedUnitHint: New Unit · Available after accepting the entire proposal

route.previewHint: Preview does not generate Lessons · Follow the Learning path after accepting

route.diffHint: Red shows original or removed content; green shows modified or added content. This preview has not been applied. Accept or reject the entire proposal in the Agent panel.
route.transferred: The original Units have moved to other stages.
route.historicalNeedsWork: Previous version passed / New Assessment suggests more practice
route.historicalUnassessed: Previous version passed / New version not yet assessed
route.unlockHint: Unlocks when all preceding Lessons are saved; passing Assessments is not required
route.generateHint: A Lesson will be generated when you enter
route.suggestionSaveFailed: Your Learning path adjustment idea was not saved. Please try again.
route.noPathHint: No Learning path has been saved. Confirm your requirements and apply a Learning path proposal to see Units here.
route.unavailableNoPathHint: The Agent is unavailable and will not generate a Learning path automatically. Existing proposals need manual confirmation; there are currently no Units or progress.
route.completedHint: Revisit any Unit to review, or discuss what to learn next with the Agent.
route.unavailableCompletedHint: Revisit any Unit to review, or save questions about what to learn next. The Agent is unavailable.

route.feedbackHint: Tell the Agent your ideas. It will suggest changes, and the Learning path will only update after you confirm.
route.unavailableFeedbackHint: The Agent is unavailable. You can save adjustment ideas, but no suggestions will be generated and the Learning path will not update automatically.
